Gold: lacking motivation. None of the generated HPI facts mention lack of motivation; low mood/depression is different and not equivalent.

Gold: headaches at work. Generated hpi-006: patient has headaches. Location/context (at work) is omitted but the core symptom (headaches) is captured.
